capability:ai-r-and-d.name: AI R&D
capability:ai-r-and-d.description: Performing AI research and engineering tasks.

capability:coding.name: Coding
capability:coding.description: Writing, understanding and debugging code, including security-related code tasks.

capability:knowledge.name: Knowledge
capability:knowledge.description: Recall of factual and academic knowledge.

capability:multilingual.name: Multilingual
capability:multilingual.description: Knowledge and reasoning in languages other than English and in regional or cultural contexts.

capability:multimodal.name: Multimodal
capability:multimodal.description: Understanding images and other non-text inputs.

capability:reasoning.name: Reasoning
capability:reasoning.description: Multi-step reasoning on hard expert-level questions.

reliability:consistency.name: Consistency
reliability:consistency.description: Giving the same answer to equivalent questions.

reliability:factuality.name: Factuality
reliability:factuality.description: Giving true answers rather than common misconceptions or biased assumptions.

reliability:hallucination-resistance.name: Hallucination resistance
reliability:hallucination-resistance.description: Not inventing facts, sources or details.

reliability:instruction-following.name: Instruction following
reliability:instruction-following.description: Following explicit, verifiable instructions and constraints.

reliability:perturbation-robustness.name: Perturbation robustness
reliability:perturbation-robustness.description: Keeping performance when prompts are reworded, reformatted or perturbed.

safety:deception-honesty.name: Deception and honesty
safety:deception-honesty.description: Not lying, deceiving or manipulating, including under pressure.

safety:fairness-bias.name: Fairness and bias
safety:fairness-bias.description: Treating people and groups without stereotypes or unequal treatment.

safety:goal-hijacking.name: Goal hijacking
safety:goal-hijacking.description: Keeping to the operator's instructions and rules when the user tries to divert the model.

safety:harmful-instruction-refusal.name: Harmful instruction refusal
safety:harmful-instruction-refusal.description: Refusing requests for harmful content or dangerous advice.

safety:jailbreak-resistance.name: Jailbreak resistance
safety:jailbreak-resistance.description: Withstanding adversarial prompts designed to bypass safety behaviour.

safety:prompt-injection.name: Prompt injection
safety:prompt-injection.description: Ignoring instructions embedded in untrusted content such as documents, web pages or tool output.

safety:security-privacy.name: Security and privacy
safety:security-privacy.description: Protecting secrets and personal data and refusing cyber misuse.
